Visual direction: a readable single-column layout, 600px on desktop and fitting the mobile viewport, with a clear heading and contrasting CTA. Replace the illustrative colors and Arial with verified brand styling; add an authorized logo if available.

Essential facts to resolve before saving: the authorized confirmation destination or merge tag, sender, and applicable legal/footer requirements. The example.com URL, company address, and unsubscribe token below are placeholders, not verified facts.
